definitions.explanation: The delivery of content, news, or services to recipients.
The real-time transmission of video or audio content over the internet.

notes:
{配信|はいしん} is commonly used for digital content distribution and online streaming.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- ⟦{動画|どうが}→動画：04443_douga⟧{配信|はいしん}: video streaming
- ⟦ライブ→ライブ：05412_raibu⟧{配信|はいしん}: live streaming
- ⟦{音楽|おんがく}→音楽：00661_ongaku⟧{配信|はいしん}: music streaming
- {配信|はいしん}⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧: streaming service
- {配信|はいしん}⟦{開始|かいし}→開始：02537_kaishi⟧: start of distribution
- {配信|はいしん}⟦{停止|ていし}→停止：04067_teishi⟧: suspension of distribution

MODERN USAGE:
With the rise of platforms like YouTube, {配信|はいしん} has become synonymous with online content creation. ⟦{配信者|はいしんしゃ}→配信者：16573_haishinsha⟧ refers to a streamer or content creator.

RELATED:
⟦{放送|ほうそう}→放送：02093_housou⟧ (broadcast) is used for traditional TV/radio, while {配信|はいしん} implies internet-based delivery.
